en: A seesaw balances when a 50-kilogram child sits 1 meter from the fulcrum and a 25-kilogram child sits 2 meters away.
Rubber tires on dry asphalt have a friction coefficient of 0.7, but ice skates on ice have a friction coefficient of only 0.03.
Earth's gravity pulls objects down at 9.8 meters per second squared, while the Moon's weaker gravity pulls them at only 1.6 meters per second squared.
Neodymium magnets are the strongest permanent magnets, capable of lifting up to 1,000 times their own weight in solid iron.
Electrical signals travel through copper wires at nearly 300,000 kilometers per second, which is almost the exact speed of light in a vacuum.
Light travels from the Sun to Earth in exactly 8 minutes and 20 seconds, covering a distance of 150 million kilometers.
Sound travels through air at 343 meters per second, but it travels nearly 15 times faster through water at 1,480 meters per second.
Tungsten has the highest melting point of any metal, remaining completely solid until it reaches a scorching 3,422 degrees Celsius.
A 1-kilogram ball dropped from a height of 10 meters possesses exactly 98 joules of gravitational potential energy before it starts falling.
A single fixed pulley requires 100 Newtons of force to lift a 10-kilogram box, but a two-pulley system requires only 50 Newtons.
A standard refrigerator magnet has a magnetic field strength of about 5 milliteslas, while an MRI machine uses a field of 3 Teslas.
A standard AA battery provides 1.5 volts of electrical potential, while a typical car battery provides 12 volts, which is eight times more.
